title: 鍋・おでんのイラスト
subject_en: Winter hot-pot and oden food items, each a separate object, kawaii soft style, warm colours Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white.
lead: 寄せ鍋、おでん、湯気のごはん。寒い季節のメニュー表やお知らせに使える12点。
items: a clay hot pot full of vegetables and tofu with steam
a bowl of oden with daikon, egg and konnyaku on a skewer
a boiled daikon slice, glossy and soft
two peeled boiled eggs, cream coloured
a block of tofu with a small green onion
two shiitake mushrooms with a cut pattern
a bundle of long green onions
a napa cabbage, pale green and yellow
three tangerines with leaves in a small basket
a steaming Japanese tea cup with a small saucer
a bowl of ramen with egg, nori and pork slices
a small pot of udon with an egg and tempura shrimp
